feed.title: New Extension Proposal for Stratum V2

entry.title: New Extension Proposal for Stratum V2
entry.summary:
The proposal in question introduces an extension to StratumV2, aimed at addressing a specific functionality gap concerning the interaction between Template Providers and the mining process. The core issue revolves around Template Providers not receiving direct feedback or proof of their block templates being utilized by mining operations. In the current setup, while they do receive shares when a block is successfully mined, there is no continuous verification mechanism during the solo-mining process, which could serve as proof that it is indeed their templates being mined.
To resolve this, the proposed extension would modify the existing workflow by routing the work shares—which are ordinarily sent from Mining Devices (ASICs) directly to Pools—also to the Template Provider. This adjustment would enable Template Providers to have immediate confirmation of their contribution to the mining effort, thereby ensuring transparency and reliability in solo-mining scenarios. Implementing such a feature would be particularly beneficial for operations where clients operate both the pools and manage ASIC connections dynamically, as is the case with the individual proposing this extension.
Furthermore, the proposal is designed to be optional, allowing Template Providers to opt-in based on their specific needs and circumstances. This flexibility ensures that the extension can cater to a wide range of use cases without imposing unnecessary changes on those who may not require this feature. For more details or to engage in the discussion surrounding this proposed extension, interested parties are encouraged to visit the ongoing discussion thread on the sv2-spec repository, which can be accessed [here](https://github.com/stratum-mining/sv2-spec/discussions/204). This forum offers an opportunity for community feedback and further refinement of the proposal.
